column1: # mapping_set_title: DDI Codebook 2.5 (extensions beyond common core) to CDIF

# mapping_set_description: Literal fields present in DDI Codebook 2.5 (codebook.xsd) but NOT in 1.2.2 (chiefly the nCube aggregate-cube branch). Extends ddi-common-to-cdif; merge the two for the full 2.5 crosswalk. Applied by DDI/ddi_to_cdif.py and DDICodebook/ddi25_to_cdif.py.
#   VERSION EXTRAS for DDI 2.5: literal fields that exist in 2.5 but not 1.2.2.
#   subject_id uses the `ddi:` (2.5) prefix. The shared core lives in
#   ddi-common-to-cdif.sssom.tsv (ddicb:); for the complete 2.5 field inventory:
#   Unmapped rows carry a blank object_id/predicate for review.

DDI 2.5 <authorizingAgency>: Name of the agent or agency that authorized the study. | DDI 2.5 (imported from DDI Lifecycle): the agency or person that authorized/approved the study-->schema:contributor[role='Authorization'].schema:Organization
DDI 2.5 <authorizationStatement>: The text of the authorization to make the material available. | DDI 2.5 (imported from DDI Lifecycle): the text of the authorization granted for the study
DDI 2.5 <studyBudget>: Describes the budget of the project in as much detail as needed. | DDI 2.5 (imported from DDI Lifecycle): description of the budget for the study/data collection
DDI 2.5 <westBL>: The westernmost coordinate delimiting the geographic extent of the dataset, in decimal degrees (-180.0 to 180.0). | west bound -> min longitude in schema:GeoShape box 'S W N E'
DDI 2.5 <eastBL>: The easternmost coordinate delimiting the geographic extent of the dataset. | east bound -> max longitude in schema:GeoShape box
DDI 2.5 <southBL>: The southernmost coordinate delimiting the geographic extent of the dataset, in decimal degrees (-90.0 to 90.0). | south bound -> min latitude in schema:GeoShape box
DDI 2.5 <northBL>: The northernmost coordinate delimiting the geographic extent of the dataset, in decimal degrees (-90.0 to 90.0). | north bound -> max latitude in schema:GeoShape box
DDI 2.5 <gringLat>: Latitude (y coordinate) of a point, expressed in decimal degrees within a range of -90.0 to 90.0. | G-ring latitude -> vertex in GeoSPARQL WKT POLYGON (geo:wktLiteral)
DDI 2.5 <gringLon>: Longitude (x coordinate) of a point, expressed in decimal degrees within a range of -180.0 to 180.0. | G-ring longitude -> vertex in GeoSPARQL WKT POLYGON (geo:wktLiteral)

DDI 2.5 <producer>: The person or organization with financial or administrative responsibility for the physical processes whereby the document was brought into existence. | DDI 2.5: producer/authority of the compliance standard - no clean dataset-level target, for review
DDI 2.5 <complianceDescription>: Text describing compliance with a standard. | DDI 2.5: narrative of standards compliance -> DQV quality annotation body (separate node)

DDI 2.5 <otherQualityStatement>: Documents quality-related information that does not fit into standard quality statement categories. | DDI 2.5: free-text quality statement -> DQV quality annotation body (separate node)

DDI 2.5 <evaluator>: Identifies persons or organizations involved in the evaluation. | DDI 2.5 (imported from DDI Lifecycle; GSBPM Evaluate phase): the organization or individual (by reference) that performed the post-completion evaluation, with an optional controlled-vocabulary role

DDI 2.5 <evaluationProcess>: Describes the evaluation process followed. | DDI 2.5 (imported from DDI Lifecycle): description of how the ex-post evaluation was carried out (methods, criteria, procedure)

DDI 2.5 <outcomes>: Describes the outcomes of the evaluation. | DDI 2.5 (imported from DDI Lifecycle): the results/findings of the ex-post evaluation - conclusions, lessons learned, recommendations for a future cycle

DDI 2.5 <description>: A container for descriptive information (mixed text and formatted content) within a development activity. | DDI 2.5 (imported from DDI Lifecycle): description of a development activity performed while designing/building the study. Out of scope for CDIF

DDI 2.5 <participant>: An individual involved in a research project's development activities. | DDI 2.5 (imported from DDI Lifecycle): a person or organization that participated in the development activity. Out of scope for CDIF

DDI 2.5 <dataSrc>: Lists the books, articles, serials, and/or machine-readable data files that served as the source(s) of the data collection. | DDI 2.5: a data source (book, article, dataset) used as a resource in the development activity. Out of scope for CDIF

DDI 2.5 <srcOrig>: For historical materials, information about the origin(s) of the sources and the rules followed in establishing them. | DDI 2.5: origin of the source - for historical materials, information about where the source resource came from. Out of scope for CDIF

DDI 2.5 <srcChar>: Assessment of the characteristics and quality of source material. | DDI 2.5: characteristics of source noted - assessment of the characteristics/quality of the source resource. Out of scope for CDIF
DDI 2.5 <srcDocu>: Level of documentation of the original sources. | DDI 2.5: documentation and access to the source resource. Out of scope for CDIF
DDI 2.5 <outcome>: Documents the results or conclusions of a development activity. | DDI 2.5 (imported from DDI Lifecycle): the outcome/result of the development activity. Out of scope for CDIF

DDI 2.5 <collectorTraining>: Describes the training provided to data collectors. | DDI 2.5 (imported from DDI Lifecycle): description of the training given to data collectors/interviewers (@type qualifies the training kind). Out of scope for CDIF

DDI 2.5 <sampleFrameName>: Name of the sample frame. | DDI 2.5 (imported from DDI Lifecycle): the name of the sampling frame from which the sample was drawn --> prov:used value is @type ["schema:CreativeWork", "prov:Entity"], and has schema:additionalType = "sampleFrame"
DDI 2.5 <labl>: A short description or label for the parent element. | DDI 2.5: a label for the sampling frame --> prov:Entity[schema:additionalType = "samplingFrame"].schema:alternateName

DDI 2.5 <txt>: Lengthier description of the parent element. | DDI 2.5: descriptive text about the sampling frame --> concatenate on prov:Entity[schema:additionalType = "samplingFrame"].schema:description

DDI 2.5 <validPeriod>: Defines a time period for the validity of the sampling frame. | DDI 2.5: the period during which the sampling frame is valid  --> concatenate on prov:Entity[schema:additionalType = "samplingFrame"].description

DDI 2.5 <custodian>: The agency or individual responsible for creating or maintaining the sample frame. | DDI 2.5: the agency or person that maintains/holds the sampling frame -->prov:Entity[schema:additionalType = "samplingFrame"].schema:owner

DDI 2.5 <confDec>: Determines whether signing of a confidentiality declaration is needed to access a resource. | DDI 2.5: use statement - whether a confidentiality declaration must be signed to access the sampling frame  -->prov:Entity[schema:additionalType = "samplingFrame"].schema:conditionsOfAccess[*]

DDI 2.5 <specPerm>: Determines whether any special permissions are required to access a resource. | DDI 2.5: use statement - whether special permissions are required to access the sampling frame -->prov:Entity[schema:additionalType = "samplingFrame"].schema:conditionsOfAccess[*]

DDI 2.5 <restrctn>: Any restrictions on access to or use of the collection. | DDI 2.5: use statement - restrictions on access to or use of the sampling frame  -->prov:Entity[schema:additionalType = "samplingFrame"].schema:conditionsOfAccess[*]

DDI 2.5 <contact>: Names and addresses of individuals responsible for the work who serve as resource persons for user inquiries. | DDI 2.5: use statement - contact person(s) for questions about accessing/using the sampling frame  -->prov:Entity[schema:additionalType = "samplingFrame"].schema:contributor[role = "Point of Contact"]
DDI 2.5 <citReq>: Text of the requirement that a data collection be cited properly in works based on it. | DDI 2.5: use statement - the citation requirement for using the sampling frame

DDI 2.5 <deposReq>: Information regarding user responsibility for informing archives of their use of the data. | DDI 2.5: use statement - requirement to deposit derived works/results based on the sampling frame -->prov:Entity[schema:additionalType = "samplingFrame"].schema:conditionsOfAccess[*]

DDI 2.5 <conditions>: Indicates any additional information that will assist users in understanding the access and use conditions of a data collection. | DDI 2.5: use statement - general conditions under which the sampling frame may be used -->prov:Entity[schema:additionalType = "samplingFrame"].schema:conditionsOfAccess[*]

DDI 2.5 <disclaimer>: Information regarding responsibility for uses of the data collection. | DDI 2.5: use statement - disclaimer of liability for use of the sampling frame -->prov:Entity[schema:additionalType = "samplingFrame"].schema:conditionsOfAccess[*]

DDI 2.5 <universe>: The group of persons or other elements that are the object of research and to which any analytic results refer. | DDI 2.5: the universe (target population) represented by the sampling frame --> DefinedTerm[about = 'Sample Frame Universe']

DDI 2.5 <unitType>: Describes the type of sampling frame unit. | DDI 2.5: the type of unit contained in the sampling frame (@isPrimary flags primary sampling units) --> DefinedTerm[about = 'Sample Frame Unit Type']
DDI 2.5 <txt>: Lengthier description of the parent element. | DDI 2.5: descriptive text about the sampling-frame unit --> DefinedTerm[about = 'Sample Frame Unit']

DDI 2.5 <referencePeriod>: Indicates the period of time in which the sampling frame was actually used for the study. | DDI 2.5: the reference period (point or range in time) to which the sampling frame applies -->concatenate on prov:Entity[schema:additionalType = "samplingFrame"].schema:description

DDI 2.5 <updateProcedure>: Description of how and with what frequency the sample frame is updated. | DDI 2.5: the procedure used to update/maintain the sampling frame->concatenate on prov:Entity[schema:additionalType = "samplingFrame"].schema:description

DDI 2.5 <instrumentDevelopment>: Describes any development work on the data collection instrument. | DDI 2.5 (imported from DDI Lifecycle): description of the development of the data-collection instrument (@type qualifies the kind). Out of scope for CDIF

DDI 2.5 <subTitl>: A secondary title used to amplify or state certain limitations on the main title. | DDI 2.5: subtitle of the cited data source

DDI 2.5 <altTitl>: A title by which the work is commonly referred to, or an abbreviation of the title. | DDI 2.5: alternative title (a title by which the source is also known) of the cited data source
